app.title: Moodle Question Bank Builder
app.subtitle: Create your Moodle XML file easily — no installation required

privacy.badge: 🔒 Your data stays on your computer
privacy.title: Your data stays private
privacy.body: Everything you type into this tool — your questions, answers, and categories — stays only on your computer, inside your browser. Nothing is sent to a server, stored online, or shared with anyone. This tool works entirely on your own machine, like software installed locally.

categories.title: Question Categories
categories.description: Organise your questions into categories. Moodle will use these to sort your questions in the question bank.
categories.empty: No categories yet. Start by adding one.
categories.deleteConfirm: Delete this category? Questions in it will be moved to 'Uncategorised'.

questions.title: Questions
questions.name: Question title (internal)
questions.empty: No questions yet. Click 'Add a question' to get started.

multichoice.correctHint: Set 100% for the correct answer, 0% for incorrect ones.

shortanswer.hint: You can use * as a wildcard (e.g. *hello*)

export.title: Export XML file
export.description: Your Moodle XML file will be generated and downloaded to your computer. You can then import it directly into Moodle.
export.noQuestions: Add at least one question before exporting.
export.saveDialogHint: A dialog will open to let you choose where to save your file.

common.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this item?

footer.privacy: No data transmitted — everything stays on your computer
